title: EIF knowledge-artifact frontmatter
description: Machine-validatable schema for the YAML frontmatter of any knowledge artifact (fact, rule, decision, etc). Mirrors core/ontology/knowledge-types.md#knowledge-artifact-metadata - this file is the enforced source, the Markdown is the explained source; keep both in sync. Validated with jsonschema's Draft202012Validator - see scripts/eif_validate_frontmatter.py.

type.description: ontology is reserved for framework-core vocabulary documents (core/ontology/*), not project knowledge artifacts. See knowledge-types.md for the single-claim vs. procedural/provenance/meta distinction that drives the evidence requirement below.

status.description: rejected is valid only when type is hypothesis - enforced below. See status-lifecycle.md.

evidence.description: Epistemic label. Required once status is not draft, for single-claim types only - see the conditional rule below and knowledge-types.md#evidence-is-not-always-one-label-per-artifact.

source.description: Evidence channel - distinct from `evidence`, which is the epistemic label. See knowledge-types.md's channel-to-axis mapping table.

confidence.description: See confidence-levels.md. Not a verification bypass - check environment/source_version/applies_to before relying on a high-confidence claim in a new context.

environment.description: e.g. staging, prod-eu, local-dev. Optional; recommended for empirical (axis B) artifacts.

source_version.description: Version of the system/library/API this claim was observed against.

applies_to.description: Free-text scope narrowing, e.g. 'Windows only', 'API v2 only'.

allOf.$comment: rejected requires type: hypothesis - status-lifecycle.md's 'rejected (type: hypothesis only)' rule, made machine-checkable.

evidence is required once status is not draft, but only for single-claim types - see knowledge-types.md#evidence-is-not-always-one-label-per-artifact for why analysis_digest/source_manifest/extraction_manifest/playbook/knowledge_operation/open_question/ontology are excluded.
